T: Hold on to something. Like dinner.
D: Two astronauts are left adrift after debris tears apart their shuttle.
P: Serve the mains when Ryan finally reaches the Chinese space station.
S: Pan-fried pork and cabbage dumplings with black vinegar and chili oil
Pork and cabbage dumplings with ginger and spring onion, pan-fried until the bottoms crisp then steamed with a splash of water, with black vinegar and chilli oil.
Boiled beef and pork dumplings tossed in butter, with sour cream
Beef and pork pelmeni filled with onion and dill, boiled until they float, tossed in butter and served with sour cream and fresh dill.
M: Chicken thighs in garam masala tomato cream sauce, with basmati rice and naan
Chicken thighs simmered in a tomato and cream curry with garlic, ginger, garam masala and kasoori methi until rich, with basmati rice and naan.
Ryan dragging herself out of the lake onto the shore

Barramundi fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, with a nutty lemon and caper brown butter, crushed potatoes and a green salad. Boil 800g baby potatoes until tender, then crush with olive oil and salt. Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets, pat very dry and season. Fry skin side down in hot oil for 5 minutes, pressing flat, then flip for 1 minute. Remove, add 60g butter and cook until nutty brown, then add 2 tbsp capers and the juice of a lemon. Spoon over the fish and serve with potatoes and salad leaves.
W: Crisp meringue clouds with whipped cream and passionfruit
Egg whites whipped with caster sugar to stiff peaks, piped into clouds, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, served with whipped cream and passionfruit pulp.
K: Fresh orange juice with ginger syrup over ice, topped with sparkling water

Freshly squeezed orange juice with a little ginger syrup and lime, topped with ice-cold sparkling water and served with an orange wheel. Simmer a sliced 4cm knob of ginger with 60g sugar and 80ml water for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Squeeze 8 oranges and a lime into a jug and stir in the ginger syrup. Chill for 30 minutes. Fill four tall glasses with ice, half fill with the juice and top with cold sparkling water. Add an orange wheel to each.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 1 day ahead, covered on a floured tray in the fridge, or freeze for 1 month; fry and steam on the night

steps.text: Mix the pork with wombok, ginger and spring onions.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry until crisp underneath.
Add water, cover and steam.
Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the filling and pleat the dumplings up to 1 day ahead, covered on a floured tray in the fridge; fry and steam on the night

steps.text: Crumble the tofu and mix with the mushrooms, soy, wombok, ginger and sliced spring onions.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry in the oil until crisp underneath.
Add water, cover and steam.
Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

dishes.make_ahead: Fold the pelmeni up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, or freeze for 1 month and boil from frozen; toss in butter on the night

steps.text: Mix the beef, pork and onion with salt and pepper.
Fill the wrappers, fold into little hats and pinch closed.
Boil until they float, plus 3 minutes.
Toss in butter.
Serve with sour cream and chopped dill.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom filling up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and fold the pelmeni up to 1 day ahead; boil on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and onion in a little of the butter until dry, season with salt and pepper and cool.
Fill the wrappers, fold into little hats and pinch closed.
Boil until they float, plus 3 minutes.
Toss in the rest of the butter.
Serve with sour cream and chopped dill.

dishes.make_ahead: Simmer the curry up to 2 days ahead and reheat gently; stir in the cream and kasoori methi, cook the rice and warm the naan on the night

steps.text: Soften the onion with ginger and garlic.
Add the garam masala and tomatoes.
Add the chicken and simmer.
Cook the basmati.
Stir in the cream and kasoori methi.
Warm the naan.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sauce with the chickpeas up to 2 days ahead; fry the paneer, add it and finish with the cream on the night

steps.text: Fry the paneer in the oil until golden and set aside.
Soften the onion with grated ginger and garlic in the same pan.
Add the garam masala, tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer.
Cook the basmati.
Stir in the paneer, cream and kasoori methi.
Warm the naan.
Whisk the egg whites with sugar to stiff glossy peaks.
Pipe into clouds on a lined tray.
Bake at 100C.
Cool in the oven.
Whip the cream and serve the meringues with cream and passionfruit pulp.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the syrup up to 1 week ahead, then chill the mixed juice jug for 30 minutes or up to 1 day; top with sparkling water and ice to serve

steps.text: Simmer the ginger with sugar and water, then strain.
Cool the syrup and squeeze the oranges and lime.
Stir the juice and syrup together in a jug.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Fill four tall glasses with ice, half fill with juice and top with sparkling water, then add an orange wheel.

s.note: Pan-fried pork and cabbage dumplings with black vinegar and chili oil
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 spring onions. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and fry until crisp underneath. Add water, cover and steam 4 minutes. Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

s.note: Boiled beef and pork dumplings tossed in butter, with sour cream
s.how: Mix 200g beef mince, 200g pork mince and 1 grated onion with salt and pepper. Fill 32 dumpling wrappers, fold into little hats and pinch closed. Boil until they float plus 3 minutes, toss in 30g butter and serve with 150g sour cream and chopped dill.

m.note: Chicken thighs in garam masala tomato cream sauce, with basmati rice and naan
m.how: Soften an onion with ginger and garlic, add 2 tsp garam masala and a tin of tomatoes. Add 1kg diced chicken thighs and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 200ml cream and a pinch of kasoori methi. Serve with 300g basmati and 4 naan.

w.note: Crisp meringue clouds with whipped cream and passionfruit
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with 180g caster sugar to stiff glossy peaks. Pipe into clouds and bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Serve with 300ml whipped cream and the pulp of 4 passionfruit.

d.note: Fresh orange juice with ginger syrup over ice, topped with sparkling water
d.how: Simmer a sliced 4cm knob of ginger with 60g sugar and 80ml water for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Squeeze 8 oranges and a lime into a jug and stir in the ginger syrup. Chill for 30 minutes. Fill four tall glasses with ice, half fill with the juice and top with cold sparkling water. Add an orange wheel to each.
